reuse.why: Extends the existing shared link guard used by all six providers, but the local unlink is a copy of the field reset inside unlinkAccount rather than a helper extracted from it and shared.

duplication.why: The eight-field db.updateAccount reset in claimBankAccount duplicates the one in app.ts unlinkAccount, so 'what unlinking leaves' now has two definitions.

placement.why: The take-over sits in accounts/link.ts where the already-linked rule lives and every provider passes the flag through; turning an assert into a mutating claim mixes validation and side effects in one function.

scope.why: Only the link parameter, the guard and focused tests change.

maintainability.why: One flag routed through one shared guard is easy to follow, but any change to how unlinking clears an account must be made in two places, and the guard now unlinks before the link itself is attempted.

bypasses_abstraction.where: claimBankAccount in accounts/link.ts re-does the local part of unlinkAccount (app.ts) instead of calling a shared local-unlink helper split out of it.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied reset block is verbatim, not reshaped.
